items.title: Federal Realty Stock: Analyst Estimates & Ratings
items.summary: Federal Realty has outperformed the broader market, with rising FFO, raised guidance, accretive acquisitions, and moderately bullish analyst sentiment.

items.title: Inflation Is Running Above 3%. These 3 Passive Income REITs Raise Rents to Keep Up.
items.summary: Consumer prices are climbing and Treasury yields are squeezing REIT valuations, yet some landlords hold a built-in raise clause. Three NYSE names take very different routes to outpace the cost of living, and one of them leaves retirees most exposed to rising rates.

items.title: Meet Wall Street’s Dependable High-Yield Dividend Stocks: 4 Companies Still Raising Their Payouts Year After Year
items.summary: Tax law forces REITs to hand over most of their income, leaving almost no cushion for mistakes. So which landlords keep lifting payouts anyway, and what separates the safe raisers from the ones quietly stretching their cash?

items.title: Buy and Hold Forever: 4 Dividend Stocks That Pay You More Every Year
items.summary: Tax law forces REITs to hand over nearly all their income, so a rising payout needs real cash growth behind it. Four equity REITs pass the test, but one has a thin cushion that could keep its raises small.

items.title: Why Investors Should Own Businesses That Can Win Under Any Administration
items.summary: The United States holds elections every two years, which is too short a period to justify a long-term investment.

items.title: 5 Dividend Stocks to Buy and Hold Forever
items.summary: These five stocks have proven track records of dividend growth backed by attractive businesses.

items.title: 4 Dividend Stocks Yielding 4% or More to Buy Before the End of November
items.summary: High yields from reliable dividend payers are what you'll get if you buy Realty Income, Federal Realty, PepsiCo, and Hormel.

items.title: 4 Dividend Kings Paying the Highest Yields Today
items.summary: Fifty years of dividend raises sounds bulletproof, yet several former Kings broke their streaks. We checked earnings and cash flow behind four of the highest yielders, and one payout looks far shakier than the rest.
